correctness.rationale: With iid Haar phases, an integer frequency gap maps phases to iid Haar phases. The two-column Gram eigenvalues are m+|S| and m-|S|. Large condition number occurs only when all m phases align; after fixing the first, the local quadratic defect is (1/2)v^T(I-11^T/m)v with determinant 1/m. Ellipsoid-volume asymptotics yield C_m=m^{m/2}/[pi^{(m-1)/2} Gamma((m+1)/2)] and t^{-(m-1)}. Tail integration gives moments iff q<m-1; m=2 follows from exact uniform relative phase and 4/pi arctan(1/t). Independent symbolic comparison to previously published small-eigenvalue formula returned ratio 1 exactly. Correctness holds for distinct integer frequencies, complex unweighted modes, fixed m>=2.
